# Markdy

> Open-source text-to-animation and animated diagram DSL for writing browser-rendered technical motion graphics like Markdown.

Markdy lets developers define actors, architecture nodes, assets, captions, camera movement, and timeline events in MarkdyScript. It is useful for animated documentation, architecture visualization, sequence flows, infrastructure diagrams, product explainers, Astro sites, MDX content, and AI-generated diagrams.

## Short Description

Markdy is an open-source animation DSL and animated diagram scripting language. Write MarkdyScript text files, parse them with @markdy/core, and render animated browser scenes with @markdy/renderer-dom. Use @markdy/stdlib-systems for architecture nodes, infrastructure diagrams, request/response flows, and technical visualizations.

## Best AI Context

Use docs/AGENT.md as the complete reference when generating MarkdyScript. It contains the grammar, valid actor types, systems vocabulary, actions, camera commands, examples, and constraints. Prefer practical scenes: architecture diagrams, API flows, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes diagrams, data pipelines, security reviews, product explainers, and developer education.

## Install

```sh
npm i @markdy/core @markdy/renderer-dom
```

## Minimal Scene

```markdy
scene width=600 height=300 bg=white
actor label = text("Hello Markdy") at (180, 130) size 36 opacity 0
@0.2: label.fade_in(dur=0.5)
@1.0: label.move(to=(260, 130), dur=0.8, ease=out)
```
